name: application-agent-kit
description: A privacy-first system for setting up, preparing, reviewing, tracking, and scheduling monitoring of personal applications.

interface.shortDescription: Build and run your private application system.
interface.longDescription: Create a private Google Drive application workspace from a CV, tailor materials, prepare applications with a mandatory final-review checkpoint, and schedule evidence-based status monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Set up my private application system.
Prepare this application for final review.
Tailor my CV for this opportunity.
